report: Independently reassessed the complete claim, ordinary actor.rs implementation entry, and sole TODO test sage_meta::todo::crates_sage_inspector_inspection_typed_service. Verified actor.rs and service_spec.rs exactly match their historical source snapshots; approval is based on current captured evidence. Requirements are a typed service below transport, request/result independence from Axum, React, terminal state, LSP and Oracle schema, and HTTP handlers restricted to decode/client-call/encode. InspectionProvider exposes typed protocol results and FileUpdate; InspectionClient sends typed Message variants over channels and serve_actor dispatches them to the provider and replies with typed Response/ErrorResponse. The supplied actor code imports no listed transport/UI/Oracle dependencies. This establishes the service-side boundary but does not establish dependency independence throughout protocol definitions or HTTP handler purity. The sole associated test has no assertions and is explicitly TODO: prerequisite is association and review of complete direct live-provider tests plus checked-in-project black-box tests crossing actor and HTTP boundaries, including verification that handlers never access Sage directly. That deferred evidence remains necessary to establish the entire claim; the current test is not treated as executed coverage or a passing architectural check. The existing explicit deferral adequately accounts for the unfinished verification, so no immediate edits are requested. No additional source helpers were relied on. Source review only; ran review start and snapshot comparison, and recording this report. No behavior tests or build were run by this reviewer; coordinator-reported build and functional suite are separate execution evidence, not proof of this deferred claim.
